it-2007-cs-29.approach: On the search path to 60, keys smaller than 60 must appear in increasing order and keys larger than 60 in decreasing order (each step narrows the interval around 60). Only the interleaving of the two chains is free: C(7,3) = 35.

Both chains are forced; only their merge is free. Choose which 3 of the 7 positions hold the larger keys:

$$\binom{7}{3} = \frac{7\cdot6\cdot5}{3\cdot2\cdot1} = 35$$
